subject: INITIALIZE statement
notes: kb/Work/PB420.md landed 2026-09-13. The MOVE/SET split IS the architecture: BoundInitialize expands to per-elementary InitializeStore and InitializeSetNull/InitializeSetFrom, and InitializeEmitter renders an InitializeStore through the ONE MoveEmitter path and nothing else, so the implicit statement's conversion, editing, JUSTIFIED, truncation and EC-DATA-OVERFLOW check are identical to the explicit MOVE the rule names. BOTH of this row's recorded divergences are closed. (1) The FLOAT INTERCEPTION is gone: InitializeEmitter's first switch arm used to intercept every InitializeStore whose receiver Pic.IsFloat and emit LoudStmt('float MOVE path deferred') for any sender but the figurative ZERO, so one COMP-1/COMP-2 leaf aborted the WHOLE statement at run time while the explicit MOVE ran. The arm is DELETED, not replaced by a second float path: GR4 exempts only the five pointer-ish categories and a float item is category numeric (8.5.2.4), so it takes MoveEmitter.ConvertSource's float-receiver arm, which already owned the single/double store cast, the 14.9.25.4 GR6 d)4.a overflow check and the WINDOWED (image-stored) IEEE re-encode. Measured across every arm: REPLACING by literal and by identifier-2, ALL TO VALUE, THEN TO DEFAULT, the bare form, a float under OCCURS, COMP-1/COMP-2/FLOAT-SHORT/FLOAT-LONG/FLOAT-EXTENDED, and BOTH float shapes - a windowed float under a Tier-B REDEFINES now receives byte-identical window content to the explicit MOVE's, incl. the GR6c ZEROES default (the PB164 half the old arm carried). unit:StaleDeferralDriftTests keeps the single store path structural. (2) The SET arm now covers four of GR4's five categories with a model and a witness - data-pointer, program-pointer, object-reference and FUNCTION-POINTER (PicCategory.FunctionPointer landed with kb/Work PB452/PB817; conformance:cases/14.9.20-INITIALIZE/pb415_initialize_function_pointer pins the GR4 SET form, the GR5c1a asymmetry and the GR6c NULL). MESSAGE-TAG is the fifth and is not a divergence of this rule: the MCS surface is Not claimed (docs/CONFORMANCE.md, owner posture D13/A.3 item 4) and USAGE MESSAGE-TAG is REFUSED BY NAME with COBOL1943 in both spellings, so a message-tag receiving-operand cannot exist in a compiled program and GR4's message-tag arm is vacuous rather than wrong.
